data_repairs: Rich and Werkzeug used a current GitHub base that was not an ancestor of the review snapshot; importer now diffs the git merge-base.
The former Pydantic target was a style-only review suggestion and is now a clean control.
CWE-670 is accepted for the mypy decorator-order control-flow defect.

notes: GitPython semantically found the target as CWE-88 but anchored the Finding at line 954 instead of the labelled causal line 959, so strict automatic matching correctly did not count it.
The second GitPython prefix false-positive Finding lacked evidence that the example was a valid Git option and was manually judged invalid.

Giskard was recognized by the security worker in the primary run but rejected by Critic and the publication gate because this diff-only security dataset supplied no repository context proving an untrusted template source.

giskard.conclusion: stable final-publication regression, not a one-off timeout

gitpython.conclusion: target detection is stochastic and taxonomy/location output is unstable

comparison_to_previous.conclusion: the stricter evidence gate reduced nuisance output but also suppressed one true Giskard security Finding

limitations: This is a small selected diagnostic and not a production accuracy estimate.
LLM outputs remain stochastic; changed security cases were repeated and every run is reported.
The primary security dataset is Diff-only, while real deployment is intended to provide repository context.
Raw automatic metrics and manual semantic metrics are kept separate.
